note: Healthcare sandbox case catalog (Mission Control spec section 17, Phase 3). Every case is entirely synthetic teaching material in the synthetichealth/synthea naming convention (numeric-suffix names mark records as generated). The sandbox module expands each case into a FHIR-shaped bundle; nothing here describes a real person.
